name: AMD Bonaire (Radeon R9 M380 class, GCN 2.0 / Sea Islands)

linux.summary: The build-to-order lower-tier GPU on some iMac17,1 units. Binds the legacy radeon driver automatically and drives the internal panel at 4K and external displays. amdgpu can be forced instead via kernel parameters.

caveats.summary: Native 5120x2880 is not available; the internal panel is limited to 3840x2160.
caveats.detail: Same DisplayPort 1.2 bandwidth ceiling as the other iMac17,1 GPUs — 5K60 needs two DisplayPort channels and does not fit on one.

workarounds.problem: You want the modern amdgpu driver instead of the legacy radeon driver.
workarounds.fix: Force Sea Islands to amdgpu via kernel parameters.
